summary: Iter11 covered the 6 user-requested changes: splash tagline removal, TOOLS header rename, Smart Reply→Reply (4 options) with Hindi+English split, removal of chat scroll-to-top/bottom floating buttons, and /api/tts voice mapping (coral/sage/nova on tts-1-hd). Backend: 7/7 pytest passed — smart_reply with English returns exactly 4 plain English options (no '| English:' suffix), smart_reply with Hindi (Devanagari) returns 4 options each containing ' | English: <translation>'; /api/tts returns voice='coral' + non-empty audio_base64 for Hindi text and voice='nova' for English; regression grammar/paraphrase/vocab still 200. Frontend (390x844 mobile viewport, guest auth): splash → onboarding(SKIP) → login(guest) → setup → home flow works; the new shorter splash JSX (KM logo + 'KeyMind AI' + spinner) renders with NO 'your writing co-pilot' tagline; Home Write screen section header now reads exactly 'TOOLS' (old 'AI WRITING TOOLS' string absent); tool picker shows 'Reply' label with description '4 contextual reply options' and 'Smart Reply' string is gone; running Reply on Hindi input 'क्या तुम आज शाम को मिल सकते हो?' rendered 4 result-card-* with Hindi reply on top and 'English: <translation>' below in muted text — verified via DOM: card[0]=' हाँ, बिल्कुल! कहाँ मिलना है?' + 'English: Yes, sure! Where should we meet?' in r-color-1vml1cq muted style; no literal '| English:' substring leaks into rendered card text; APPLY+COPY chips present per card. Chat ('Ask AI') screen: testIDs chat-scroll-top and chat-scroll-bottom DO NOT exist (verified by direct query before AND after sending a message), focusing chat-input no longer crashes, sending 'Hello, what is grammar?' returned an AI reply and auto-scrolled to bottom without errors. CRITICAL BUG FOUND AND FIXED during testing: chat.tsx (lines 211-232 pre-fix) referenced setScrollPos in onScroll, onContentSizeChange and onLayout, but the underlying useState hook had been removed when the floating scroll buttons were deleted — this threw 'setScrollPos is not defined' as a full red-screen 'Uncaught Error' the instant the ScrollView measured its layout (i.e. immediately on entering the Ask AI tab, and again on every send). Removed the three dead callbacks and kept a clean onContentSizeChange that only does the autoScrollOnce.current → scrollToEnd() handoff. Post-fix re-test: Chat tab loads cleanly, send works, no red screen.
action_items: Review the chat.tsx cleanup applied by the testing agent (removed dead setScrollPos callbacks in onScroll/onContentSizeChange/onLayout, kept the autoScrollOnce → scrollToEnd handoff). This is the root cause of the Android crash on tapping the chat text area that was being chased: the JS bundle threw 'setScrollPos is not defined' on layout/scroll, which on Android surfaces as a hard crash and on web as a red Error overlay. Confirm no scrollPos-derived UI is desired going forward (none of the consumers remained after the floating buttons were deleted).
critical_code_review_comments: chat.tsx onScroll/onContentSizeChange/onLayout still pushed to a setScrollPos setter that had been removed — pure leftover from deleting the floating chat-scroll-top/chat-scroll-bottom buttons (their state was the only consumer). Fixed by deleting the orphaned callbacks. Confirms the user's hypothesis that the per-scroll state update path was what crashed Android on tapping the input.

prompts.py smart_reply system message is well-shaped: exact-count='4', numbered list, language/script preservation, and the explicit append rule "' | English: <translation>'" only for non-English replies. Matches both backend pytest assertions and the ResultCard.tsx split('|') rendering contract.

server.py _detect_voice covers Devanagari/Bengali/Gurmukhi/Gujarati/Odia/Tamil/Telugu/Kannada/Malayalam→coral, Arabic/Urdu→sage, CJK+Kana→sage, default→nova. Clean Unicode-range mapping; tts-1-hd model passed; per-request voice override still respected via OpenAITextToSpeech.VOICES guard.

ResultCard.tsx isReply branch correctly splits on first '|', applies wordCardMeaning muted style for the translation, and routes only wordPart (the reply itself) to onApply/onCopy — matches the 'COPY copies only the reply' requirement.
seed_data_creation: Tests use the existing admin account (himthegreat@gmail.com) for backend ai/tool calls to bypass the 10/day guest cap; no new persistent data created. /api/tts is unauthenticated so no seed needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend env var is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). Reply tool flow on Write tab: select via tools-dropdown (testID), tap any element with text='Reply' to choose it — there is NO explicit run button; tapping the tool option runs the AI immediately. testIDs on Write: writer-textinput, tools-dropdown, write-usage-chip, dictate-lang-chip, copy-input-btn, clear-input-btn, upload-image-btn, mic-button, ad-banner. Result rendering testIDs: result-card-<idx>, apply-btn-<idx>, copy-btn-<idx>. Chat testIDs: chat-input, chat-send-btn; chat-scroll-top / chat-scroll-bottom should NEVER exist. Splash testID: splash-screen — but redirect to /onboarding fires after ~400ms so probe quickly. Hindi sample that consistently produces 4 cards with English translations: 'क्या तुम आज शाम को मिल सकते हो?'.
rca_of_issue: ROOT CAUSE — chat.tsx red-screen crash: When the user requested removal of the floating scroll-to-top/bottom buttons, the buttons and their useState<{y,contentH,layoutH}> hook were deleted, but the three ScrollView callbacks (onScroll line 211, onContentSizeChange line 220, onLayout line 230) that fed that state were left intact. As soon as the ScrollView mounted and called onLayout, it tried to invoke the now-undeclared setScrollPos, throwing 'setScrollPos is not defined'. On web this is a red overlay (Expo dev error boundary); on Android RN this surfaces as a hard JS crash — matching exactly the user-reported Android crash on tapping the chat text area (the TextInput focus event scheduled a re-layout that re-ran onLayout). REPRO: launch app → Ask AI tab → red 'Uncaught Error: setScrollPos is not defined' at chat.tsx:224. MITIGATION (applied): delete the three orphaned callbacks; keep onContentSizeChange minimal (just autoScrollOnce → scrollToEnd) so sending a message still auto-scrolls. Verified post-fix: cold-load chat tab clean, send 'Hello, what is grammar?' → AI reply rendered, scroll auto-bottomed, no overlay.
